<thought>We need to locate a retrosynthetic template that corresponds to a Diels‑Alder cycloaddition. The forward reaction forms two C–C single bonds and converts two C=C double bonds into single bonds, i.e., the bond order changes from double to single for two C=C bonds. We will search the template catalog for templates that break two alkenes (functional_groups_broken = ["alkene"]) and form two alkanes (functional_groups_formed = ["alkane"]). Then we will test the returned templates on the target molecule using check_smiles_reaction_template_matching to find the one that matches. Once a matching template is found, we will retrieve its mapped reaction SMILES with map_reaction_smiles (if needed) and return the mapped_rxn together with the template_id.
